entries.name: Agent Goal Hijack
entries.outcome: Attacker redirects agent objectives via prompts, tools, or poisoned context.

entries.name: Tool Misuse
entries.outcome: Legitimate tools are invoked or chained in harmful ways beyond intended use.

entries.name: Identity and Privilege Abuse
entries.outcome: Agent credentials or delegated identity are over-scoped or stolen.

entries.name: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
entries.outcome: MCP/A2A plugins, tools, or runtime components are compromised.

entries.name: Unexpected Code Execution
entries.outcome: Natural-language or tool paths lead to unintended code or command execution.

entries.name: Memory and Context Poisoning
entries.outcome: Persistent memory/context is tainted to change later behavior.

entries.name: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
entries.outcome: Spoofed or weakly authenticated agent-to-agent messages misdirect workflows.

entries.name: Cascading Failures
entries.outcome: Local faults amplify across automated multi-agent pipelines.

entries.name: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
entries.outcome: Convincing agent output induces humans to approve harmful actions.

entries.name: Rogue Agents
entries.outcome: Misaligned, concealed, or self-directed agent behavior outside policy.
